Each post sets `section:` in its front matter. `hue` colours the section's cover art, `icon` picks its illustration (passport, briefcase, euro, home, chart), `resources` lists resource categories from resources.json shown as official sources; `photo` is the section's photo from photos.json (also used by its articles without their own).
